name: ai-review
description: AI 二次審查 - 使用 Claude Code CLI 或 Antigravity CLI 對程式碼、計畫或技術決策進行獨立審查（Codex 宿主外審用；runner 另支援 Codex reviewer 供 Claude Code 宿主）。

interface.shortDescription: Run Claude Code or Antigravity as independent reviewers.
interface.longDescription: AI 二次審查 workflow for code, plans, and technical decisions. It packages a shared skill and local runner that can invoke Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, or Antigravity CLI (reviewer picked by host, so the reviewer is never the host itself). Defaults: Claude Code uses claude-opus-4-6[1m] with max effort; Antigravity uses 3.5-flash; Codex follows ~/.codex/config.toml.
defaultPrompt: 用 ai-review 審查目前未提交變更
